notes: Drought-tolerant grain alternative to corn. Atrazine-tolerant rotation crop.

sprayWindows.title: PRE residual at planting (Group 15, safened seed only)
sprayWindows.body: Apply a Group 15 residual herbicide (acetochlor, dimethenamid or metolachlor) at planting, before the sorghum emerges. Use sorghum seed treated with an approved seed safener for Group 15 herbicides.

sprayWindows.title: PRE atrazine at planting
sprayWindows.body: Atrazine goes on preemergence, after planting and before the sorghum emerges. Sorghum is not as tolerant to atrazine as corn; follow the atrazine use restrictions on the label.

sprayWindows.title: POST atrazine, four to five weeks after planting
sprayWindows.body: Control weeds that came up with the crop four to five weeks after planting. Apply atrazine before sorghum exceeds 12 inches and before weeds are 1.5 inches tall.
